{"metadata":{"description":"<img","id":"gh:1338357371","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-edit-message","slug":"WyxBUPT-22/dsh-plugin-edit-message","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-edit-message"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: **edit the last user message back into
the composer after sto"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"pping a turn** — no more retyping from scratch."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Sending a message, stopping the reply, and wanting to re-ask with a small
change currently means typ"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ing the whole prompt again. This plugin adds an
"Edit last message" button to the composer tool row:"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" it restores the tail user
message text and focuses the input, ready to edit and send."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It is a **client-side plugin** — the conversation log stays append-only. Sending
the edited text app"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ends a new turn (the original message and the interrupted
reply remain in the transcript). It never "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"touches the host, the session log,
or the agent loop."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin bundles as a `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` package. It works on any
DSH setup that loads th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ird-party bundles (source `dsh web`, DSH Desktop,
custom profiles)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From npm (published — recommended)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Restart the GUI (fully quit and reopen) after installing — client plugin
bundles register at startup"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"estart the GUI (fully quit and reopen) after installing — client plugin
bundles register at startup."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**DSH Desktop users:** Desktop's `DSH_HOME` lives under
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness`, so target t"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"sers:** Desktop's `DSH_HOME` lives under
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness`, so target that explicitly:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then quit and reopen DSH Desktop."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### From GitHub or a local checkout (unpublished builds)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### From this source checkout"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The repository is self-contained: devDependencies resolve the official
harness client packages from "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"the npm registry, so no `deepseek-harness`
checkout is needed."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-plugin-edit-message`.
See `docs/user/develop/"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"basic/publish.md` in the harness checkout for the
`dsh plugin` workflow."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Registers one client plugin (`dsh.client` manifest, `platform: web`) that
contributes an entry to "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"the official `conversation.input.left` composer
tool-row slot (a documented multi-plugin list slot —"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" zero official changes).
- The button renders only while the session is idle, a tail user/steering
m"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"essage exists, and that message is plain text (draft images are browser
File-backed and cannot be re"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"surrected from the durable log).
- On click: `inputActions.setDraft(text)` restores the text and the"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" composer
is focused. The plugin prefers `inputActions.focus` when the deployed
runtime exposes it, "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"otherwise it focuses the editable surface —
`[data-composer-input]` on harness 0.1.2+ (a Lexical-dri"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ven
`contenteditable`), with the legacy composer `<textarea>` as the last
fallback.
- If you remove "},{"id":"p22s9","text":"the plugin (`dsh plugin remove dsh-plugin-edit-message`), the
surface disappears entirely — the tool"},{"id":"p22s10","text":" row reverts to official chrome."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The plugin tracks the harness client contract, which was reshaped twice inside
the **0.1.2** line:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"1. `0.1.2-alpha` split the monolithic `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` into
`dsh-client-store` + th"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e `dsh-client-ui-*` family, and moved the transcript
off `SessionSnapshot` (whose `chat` field no lo"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nger exists) onto the Chat
target published per Conversation binding, reached through the `useChat`
"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"standard hook.
2. `0.1.2-rc.1` stopped handing the composer tool row its `InputZone` owner
props: th"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"e responder now calls
`renderSlot("conversation.input.left", {})`. Session lifecycle therefore
comes"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" from the `useSession` standard hook, which ui-session contributes for
every session-scoped slot on "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"ion` standard hook, which ui-session contributes for
every session-scoped slot on every 0.1.2 build."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Plugin | Harness / DSH Desktop | Reads |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| 0.1.5+ | 0.1.2-alpha.1 … 0.1.2-rc.1 (Desktop 0.7.x / 0.8.x) | `useChat` + `useSession`; **no owner"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" props** |
| 0.1.4 | 0.1.2-alpha.1 … 0.1.2-alpha.5 (Desktop 0.7.x) | `useChat` + the `InputZone` own"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"er prop |
| ≤ 0.1.3 | 0.1.0-rc.x (Desktop ≤ 0.5.0) | `session.chat` |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Both 0.1.2 breaking changes fail the slot silently for older builds — the button
simply never appear"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s, with the crash below in the console:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Differences from in-transcript editing (Codex style)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"In-place replacement with a rewind of the log tail is a larger design
(log-truncation semantics, com"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"paction checkpoints, session log format, dual
SDK projections) and is intentionally out of scope. Th"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"is plugin provides the
interaction value — edit the text, resend — with zero blast radius."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Develop"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"`pnpm publish` runs `prepublishOnly` (typecheck + test + build) first."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Friends"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"https://linux.do"}],"truncated":false}
